facts.fact: The digital ministry's page says Mauritania joined the World Bank-supported WARDIP to strengthen implementation of its digital transformation strategy, and that WARDIP will serve as a lever to attract private investment and co-financing for the activities planned in the 2022-2025 digital transformation agenda; page published 2026-09-21, used as the date.

systems.owner: Ministère de la Transformation numérique (project management unit)

note: The page does not describe the agenda's scope, so its class is left empty; the fact (World Bank-supported WARDIP as co-financing lever) is recorded with class empty.
